items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 34:1
items.html: Through the correction of clothing in the MEM-LAMED-TZADIK that was made in Atzilut, the light of Hochma was diminished from the first three of every Partzuf, which were corrected in the MEM of Tzelem, and it was also thickened in its bestowal through the LAMED of Tzelem, being only the aspect of the VAK of Hochma. As in Answer 11 above. (Part 1, Page 304, Item 21).
